title: Verify Events API setup
content_data: # Verify that events are received correctly Navigate to **Tools** > **Events** > **Data sources**. This will take you to the detail page of your CRM Event Set. Under the **Overview** tab, you can check if we have received your events. To view the latest status, refresh the page. - If we have received your events sent from Events API, you will see "**Server**" under **Connection Method**. - If we have received your events sent directly from your browser via file upload, you will see "**Browser**" under **Connection Method**.
seo_title: Verify CRM Events API setup | TikTok API for Business
seo_description: Familiarize yourself with the steps to verify CRM data connection setup. Read the guide to help you get the task done right.
